stories.title: Plaid and Conservative MSs say Flintshire is ignoring residents on Catholic super-school
stories.summary: Senedd Members from Plaid Cymru and the Conservatives have criticised Flintshire County Council’s decision to restart the consultation on closing four Catholic schools. stories.title: Council leader says Saltney Ferry school plans prove it’s not a ‘forgotten town’
stories.summary: The leader of Flintshire Council says plans to close a primary school in Saltney Ferry as part of a merger plan prove that Saltney is not a forgotten town. stories.title: Penalty notices issued after Flintshire Council Blue Badge checks in Mold
stories.summary: Officers checked 78 Blue Badges at Mold Market this week and found four were invalid, Flintshire County Council has said. Two of the invalid badges were seized immediately. stories.title: Ewloe roundabout disruption to continue into mid-July, council confirms
stories.summary: Months of disruption at the Ewloe and St David’s roundabouts will continue into mid-July after Flintshire County Council confirmed an overrun on its active travel works programme. stories.title: Public Health Wales monitoring Welsh residents linked to MV Hondius hantavirus outbreak
stories.summary: A small number of Welsh residents linked to a hantavirus outbreak on a Dutch cruise ship are being checked daily by Public Health Wales.
